content: Naturally, the model only copes with some kinds of errors and fails on others – for instance, word order is restored, as long as it does not affect the perception of the meaning. On the other hand, we do not expect orthographic variations like typos to be fixed reliably, since they affect the sub-word segmentation of the input and thus can hinder the translation.
